mapper.select: select c.category_seq, c.parent_seq, c.name, p.name as parent_name, c.enabled from tbl_category c join tbl_category p on p.category_seq = c.parent_seq order by p.sort_order, p.category_seq, c.sort_order, c.category_seq
select c.category_seq, c.parent_seq, c.name, p.name as parent_name, c.enabled from tbl_category c join tbl_category p on p.category_seq = c.parent_seq where c.category_seq = #{categorySeq}

select q.question_seq, q.category_seq, q.content, q.question_type, q.required, q.sort_order, q.enabled, to_char(q.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as regdate, (select count(distinct a.request_seq) from tbl_request_answer a where a.question_seq = q.question_seq) as answer_count, (select count(*) from tbl_question_option o where o.question_seq = q.question_seq and o.enabled = 'Y') as option_count from tbl_question q where q.category_seq = #{categorySeq} order by q.enabled desc, q.sort_order, q.question_seq

select q.question_seq, q.category_seq, p.name || ' > ' || c.name as category_name, q.content, q.question_type, q.required, q.sort_order, q.enabled, (select count(distinct a.request_seq) from tbl_request_answer a where a.question_seq = q.question_seq) as answer_count, o.option_seq, o.content as option_content, o.sort_order as option_sort_order, o.enabled as option_enabled, (select count(*) from tbl_request_answer a where a.option_seq = o.option_seq) as option_answer_count from tbl_question q join tbl_category c on c.category_seq = q.category_seq left join tbl_category p on p.category_seq = c.parent_seq left join tbl_question_option o on o.question_seq = q.question_seq where q.question_seq = #{questionSeq} order by o.sort_order, o.option_seq
mapper.insert:
select seq_question.nextval from dual
insert into tbl_question (question_seq, category_seq, content, question_type, required, sort_order, enabled) values (#{questionSeq}, #{categorySeq}, #{content}, #{questionType}, #{required}, #{sortOrder}, 'Y')
insert into tbl_question_option (option_seq, question_seq, content, sort_order, enabled) values (seq_question_option.nextval, #{questionSeq}, #{content}, #{sortOrder}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: update tbl_question set enabled = #{enabled} where question_seq = #{questionSeq}
